title: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas act on Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences ₹1,500 crore QIP
description: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited (KIMS), one of the key healthcare corporate groups in India, has raised ₹1,500 crore (approx. USD 158 million) from a Qualified Institutions Placement.Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised KIMS on this QIP.The transaction team comprised of Prashant Gupta (Partner and National Practice Head - Capital Markets), Ruth Chenchiah (Partner), Ritika Khare (Principal Associate), Anoushka PV (Senior Associate), Anaya Jain (Associate) and Kunika Agarwal
